card.name: Pieces of ALL-CAPS words
card.fires_on: Partway through words or small linking words written in ALL CAPS, mostly in capitalized warning or adverse-reaction text. The marked piece is followed by more capitalized text.

modes.label: Inside capitalized words
modes.description: A middle piece of a longer word typed in capitals.
modes.example: THERE AP<<PE>>ARS TO BE AN INCREASED R

modes.label: Capitalized warning headings
modes.description: The word LIFE after SERIOUS AND in a capitalized boxed warning.

card.writes: It promotes capitalized words such as YES, MAX and ABS, which pushes the model to continue in all caps.
card.plain: It fires on pieces of words in ALL-CAPS label text and helps the model keep writing in capitals.
